concepts.definition: A measurable input property of an example that a model uses for prediction.
The correct answer for an example, which a supervised model learns to predict.
Encoding a nominal category as one binary column per category.

questions.q: How would you encode a feature 'payment method' with values card, transfer and cash?
questions.a: One-hot encoding into three binary columns.

questions.q: Why must preprocessing be fitted on training data only?
questions.a: Fitting on all data leaks test information into training and inflates scores.
